Name: DynamicGroups
Description: Rule-based Active Directory groups: Update-DynamicGroups.ps1 adds and removes users so each managed group matches its rule. This file is copied with the application (bump Version whenever a file of the application changes); the rules themselves stay on the server in Data\Rules\DynamicGroupRules.json and are never overwritten by a copy or sync. A server that needs other values gets DynamicGroups.<COMPUTERNAME>.json next to this file.
RunAs: SYSTEM on a domain controller; elsewhere a gMSA or domain account with delegated rights on the group OUs

Notes.DefaultSearchBase: Users are searched here (and below) when a rule has no SearchBase.
Notes.DefaultGroupPath: OU offered for new rules in the editor.
Notes.Server: Domain controller to use. Empty = a writable DC is discovered at each run.
Notes.RulesFile: Relative to the application folder. Server-local: edited with Show-DynamicGroupEditor.ps1, previous versions kept in Data\Rules\Backups.
Notes.RulesTemplate: Copied to RulesFile by Install-DynamicGroups.ps1 when the server has no rules yet.
